notes: ACCESS: HTTP-first tier (a) only - curl with browser UA, no blocks encountered; robots.txt is Shopify-standard, allows general crawling, no Claude-specific disallow. TREE: built from union of homepage mega-menu HTML (accordion sections under parentCategory=Home: Dinnerware, Serveware, Drinkware, Decor, Barware, Textile, Furniture) and sitemap_collections_1.xml. Textile accordion exposes 4 leaf subcategories (Bedding/bedcovers, Cushion Covers/cushion-covers, Table Linen/table-linen, Rugs & Curtains/rugs-curtains) under an 'All Textile' view-all (134 total) - per parent-URL rule the view-all was not recorded, only a grouping row plus its 4 children. Storage: only one genuine storage node found, 'Storage Baskets' (/collections/storage-baskets, page titled 'Timeless Storage Solutions'), nested as a leaf inside the Decor accordion (not a distinct top-level Storage parent in nav) - confirmed via product names (Ceylon Bamboo Basket, Mirage Abaca Trunk/Round Basket, Mosaic Basket) that these are genuine storage baskets/trunks, not purely decorative; recorded as a single leaf row with no synthetic grouping parent since no 'Storage' parent node exists in the site's own hierarchy. QTY: each row's qty taken from the embedded moeApp.collection.productCount JS field on that exact collection page (Shopify Moengage analytics block), cross-checked against the page's own <title>/moeApp.collection.title matching the requested handle on every leaf. EXCLUDED: Decor accordion's other children (Votives & Candle Holders, Candles & Fragrances, Home Accents, Vases & Planters, Photo Frames, Jewellery Holders & Trinkets) - Decorative Home Accessories, out of scope for this task. Dinnerware/Serveware/Drinkware/Barware (glasses, mugs, flatware, bar tools) - Kitchen & Dining/Barware, out of scope. Furniture and Bar Furniture - Furniture, out of scope. Apparel collections (sarees, dupattas, kurtas, shirts, scarves, bags) - apparel/fashion, excluded per textile.md S19. Cushion Covers is cross-linked from both the Decor and Textile menu sections to the identical URL /collections/cushion-covers - recorded once under Textile only (genuine textile product per textile.md S4), not duplicated. Rugs & Curtains combines rugs and shower-curtain products on one single site-defined collection page with no further sub-split in nav or on-page - recorded as one row matching the site's own category name. Checked two sitemap-only collections not present in current nav or in the Textile page's own strip - /collections/bath-linen (moeApp productCount=0, orphaned/deprecated, not linked from homepage nav or Textile collection) and /collections/wallcoverings (productCount=3, also unlinked from nav) - excluded as stale/non-navigable sitemap artifacts, not genuine current category pages. No blocks at any tier; all fetches tier (a) HTTP only.
